reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "200 mg" and "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR on the front, and the sachets fit in my work bag. If a creator's video is about sleeping badly, I would tap the orange cart on impulse, but I would try one box only.
objection: 30 little foil packets feels like more trash, and I am paying $30 for something I have not tried yet. I also do not know if I will actually take it every day.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller trial box at a lower price, or a creator I trust saying it helped her sleep.
